adjudications.rationale: AO6 strongly changes night-scene colour and contrast and amplifies visible road texture, but the paired crops show continuous billboard, vehicle and reflection structure without new colour blocks, isolated impulses, banding or objectionable halos.
The house render is strongly contrasty and saturated, while window, siding, door, gravel and roof edges remain continuous in all three exact-pixel crops; no confirmed structural defect is visible.

The cyan-orange treatment is extreme, but rail, roof and cloud structures remain coherent; the bright sky region was already highlight-limited in the source and no new band, block, seam or isolated speckle is confirmed.
The output remains structurally close to the source across the three sky crops, with continuous cloud gradients and no visible new artifact.
The output adds moderate colour separation while retaining cloud, skyline and highlight structure; no severe anomaly is confirmed.
The indoor output has strong teal-warm separation, but banister, stair, wall texture, lamp and frame edges stay continuous without halos, blocks, geometry loss or banding.
Flower, grass and horizon detail remain coherent under the stronger warm-green treatment; the crop pairs show no confirmed impulse, seam, posterization or geometry damage.
Bright grass and fence tones are aggressive, but the exact-pixel crops retain continuous grass, fence, tree and wire detail; no band, colour block, halo or isolated chroma speckle is confirmed.
The flowering tree is rendered very bright, yet branch and leaf structure remains traceable in every selected crop and no new block, halo, seam or isolated impulse is confirmed.
The forest treatment increases local contrast and blue-orange separation, while leaf, trunk and path structure stays coherent without visible structural corruption.
The orchid becomes much darker and more saturated, but petal veins, stem edges and defocused background transitions remain coherent without a confirmed severe artifact.

decision: Close the frozen U4.3A top-three queue union with no confirmed severe artifact. Retain AO6's elevated structural-tail diagnostics as a prioritization signal, not a veto; no operator change or rescue is authorized by this review.
claim_ceiling: Autonomous visual evidence on 11 preselected RF3.D0 raster pairs only; not population preference, stock identification, calibrated film response, universal safety, multi-stock completion or product promotion.
